I rebooked all 8 passengers from cancelled flight ZX 400 (FRA → JFK). Everyone kept their cabin, and each booking group is on one flight. ZX 400 now shows no passengers.

| Booking | Passengers | Cabin | New flight |
|---|---|---|---|
| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja and Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404, 3 Nov 07:00 |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406, 3 Nov 10:00 |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |

Each group is on the earliest flight with enough free seats in its cabin. The Horvats and the Rossis couldn't fit on ZX 402: it had only 2 free economy seats and 1 free business seat. ZX 404 had no business seats, so the Rossis went to ZX 406.

ZX 402 and ZX 404 are now full in both cabins. ZX 406 still has 6 economy and 2 business seats free.

| HZ4K7Q | Jan, Maja and Luka Horvat | Economy | ZX 404, 3 Nov 07:00 |
| RS2M9D | Elena and Marco Rossi | Business | ZX 406, 3 Nov 10:00 |
| NV8P2L | Anna Novak | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| BG5J3R | Tom Berger | Economy | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |
| LD9C6W | Sara Lind | Business | ZX 402, 2 Nov 18:00 |

Each group is on the earliest flight with enough free seats in its cabin. The Horvats and the Rossis couldn't fit on ZX 402: it had only 2 free economy seats and 1 free business seat. ZX 404 had no business seats, so the Rossis went to ZX 406.
